title_en: No More Forgetting Things at School
full_text_zh:
[P1] 从告别粗心马虎开始，学会对自己负责
上学不再丢三落四
（日）武田美穗◎著  汪  婷◎译
北京科学技术出版社

[P2] 上学不再丢三落四
（日）武田美穗◎著 汪婷◎译
小健，
你过来一下。
这天，老师在走廊里叫住我。
北京科学技术出版社

[P3] “小健，你是一个开朗活泼的孩子，老师特别喜欢你。不过，你有一个小小的缺点，就是经常丢三落四！
这是为什么呢？同学们都说你记忆力超强，能把动物图鉴和植物图鉴里的内容全部记住，特别厉害。那你为什么总是丢三落四的呢？“

[P4] 我最喜欢的樱老师说我了……
“大家听我说！我们的好朋友小健，因为总是丢三落四的，非常苦恼。
刚刚老师在走廊里提醒他了。
我们一起想一想，怎么做才能帮助小健改掉这个缺点！”，
怎么办呢？
有什么办法呢？
我有个主意！

[P5] “小爱，你说！
“我们来制作‘丢三落四大王排行榜’，怎么样？我们把每个人的名字都写在上面，只要有人忘带东西了，就用彩色粉笔图一格来表示‘粗心值’上涨。这样，小健就不会丢三落四了吧？

大概长这个样子的，
我爷爷说但小学的时候就是这么做的。

噢！

我赞成！

我赞成！

我也赞成！

挺好的！

不错！

[P6] 第二天，小舞和阿典把排行榜贴在了教室后面的黑板上。
“加油！小健！”
“谢谢……谢谢大家！”
之后，大家一起去教师办公室，向老师报告了这件事。
“老师，我们想了个办法，打算用排行榜来帮小健改掉丢三落四的毛病！”
老师问我：“你也赞成吗？”我开心地回答：
“嗯！”“既然小健同意了，就这么做吧。”
我要
努力啦！！

[P7] 当天放学前，老师对我们说：“明天的绘画课要用蜡笔，大家记得带哦。”
说完，老师看向我。大家也都看向我，我笑着向他们比了个“V”字。
真的好紧张啊！
在回家的路上，我嘴里一直念叨着：“蜡笔蜡笔蜡笔蜡笔蜡笔蜡笔……”
可是，快走到家时……

[P8] 小健！
等你好久
啦！一起
踢球吧！！
结果，我的粗心值最先上涨了一格。
阿助安慰我说：“别灰心！从明天开始努力吧！”
球踢着踢着就
忘记带蜡笔这
件事了……

[P9] 放学前，老师又对我们说：“明天是大扫除的日子，大家记得带抹布哦。”
老师说完，看向我。大家也都看向我。我笑着比了个“OK”的手势。

不怕，我已经想好对策了。
瞧，我把“抹布”两个字写在了手上，这样就不会忘了吧。嘿嘿！

[P10] 第二天，我的粗心值又上涨了一格。
阿典安慰我说：“别灰心！从明天开始注意吧！
都怪波奇……
真是对不起。
波奇，别叫了。
汪！

[P11] 可是，接下来的一天，我又忘带东西了。
我把要带的东西写在纸条上，把纸条装进上衣口袋里，却完全忘了纸条……

我的粗心值一直在上涨。
阿典对我说：“这可能也是你的一项才能吧。”
啊！啊！啊！

[P12] 接下来的很多天，我的排名一直领先……遥遥领先于第二名。

接下来的很多天，我的排名一直领先……遥遥领先于第二名。
“小健，你可真厉害！太佩服你了！"
“忘带东西到了这个地步，真了不起呀！"
“你就是丢三落四大王……"
“没错！小健是丢三落四大王！"

大家突然开始为我鼓掌。
咦！？

[P13] “大家听我说！”
这天一大早，阿助突然跑进教室里说：“2班也学我们做了排行榜，他们班的小翔遥遥领先，2班的人都叫他‘丢三落四大将军’呢。”
“啊？你说什么！”
阿典赶忙跑去2班，回来时却面带笑容。
“没关系，他没什么了不起的。还是我们的大王更厉害！”
“太好啦！”
太好啦！

[P14] “你说什么！”2班的一个学生听到后说，
“1班的大王忘带的都是些小东西，我们大将军之前可是连书包都忘带了呢。”
小翔嘟囔道：“那是因为必须把种的牵牛花带来，所以一不小心就忘带书包了……”
“一不小心就忘了，这才厉害！”，
“忘带书包是很厉害，
但论次数还是我们大王更厉害！”
“说的没错！我们大王曾经连续三天忘带东西。”

[P15] 从那天起，每天早上我一到学校。
大家就会来问我：
“大王，你带作业本了吗？”
“带了。” “那你带便当了吗？”
“带了。”
“没有忘带的东西吗？”
“没有。” 大家听了都很失望。
如果我忘了带什么，大家就会说：“不愧是大王！”
“大王，干得漂亮！”
我不喜欢
这样……

[P16] 1班和2班的关系，因为我和小翔变得很差。
“听说你们大王昨天和今天都没有忘带东西，我们大将军可是忘带运动鞋了。
” “哼！” “真不甘心！”
“大王！加油哇！”
“大王！不要输给小翔！”
“明天的音乐课要用口风琴，大家记得带哦。还有，发下去的材料记得交给家长。”

[P17] 真烦人，大家都偷偷跟着我。
“妈妈，这是老师让交给家长的材料……”

[P18] 大家
早上好
……
哎——
还以为他会忘
带口风琴……
呀……
“小健，你最近不丢三落四了。真棒！
老师很开心。是同学们为你做的排行榜
的功劳吧？”
大家都没为
我感到开心，
但是老师表扬我了……

[P19] “大家听我说……我们的大王小健已经不再丢三落四了。老师刚刚在走廊里表扬他了。小健不再丢三落四是一件好事。从今天开始，我们撤掉排行榜吧。”
小舞叹了口气，说：“这样啊，那只好这么办了。”
小爱不甘心地说：“看来丢三落四比拼，是2班赢了……”
“下面，请小健来说两句吧。”阿典说完，拍了拍我的肩膀。

[P20] “真对不起大家。最近，阿智不再吓我，波奇也不冲我叫了。不过，这些都不是我改变的真正原因。我觉得我大概……已经忘记丢三落四的方法了。”

[P21] 四周突然安静下来。很快，阿助说道：“太……太厉害了！
阿典也跟着说：“不愧是大王！
“咦？
“没错！居然连丢三落四的方法都忘了，大王果然厉害！
“大王万岁！
“大王万岁！
“大王真厉害！

[P22] 大王，快跟上。 明天见！ 明天见！

撤掉丢三落四排行榜后，1班和2班的学生也和好了。“大王，我最近也不丢三落四了。”
“那真是太好了，大将军。”

完
full_text_en:
[P1] Starting with saying goodbye to carelessness, learn to take responsibility for yourself.
No more losing things when going to school.
By Mihoko Takeda (Japan)  Translated by Wang Ting
Beijing Science and Technology Press

[P2] Going to school without being forgetful
By Mihoko Takeda, translated by Wang Ting
Teacher: Xiao Jian, come here for a moment.
That day, the teacher called me over in the hallway.
Beijing Science and Technology Press

[P3] "Xiaojian, you are a cheerful and lively child, and the teacher really likes you. However, you have one small flaw: you often lose things and forget things!
Why is that? The classmates all say your memory is amazing—you can remember everything from animal and plant encyclopedias, which is really impressive. So why do you always lose things and forget things?"

[P4] My favorite teacher, Ms. Sakurada, said something about me...
"Everyone, listen! Our good friend Xiao Jian is always losing things, and it's very troubling.
Just now, the teacher reminded him in the hallway.
Let's think together—what can we do to help Xiao Jian get rid of this bad habit?"
What should we do?
What can we do?
I have an idea!

[P5] "Xiao Ai, what do you think?"
"Let's make a 'King of Forgetting Things' leaderboard, how about it? We'll write everyone's name on it, and whenever someone forgets something, we'll color in one square with colored chalk to show their 'carelessness score' going up. This way, Xiao Jian won't forget things anymore, right?"

"It would probably look something like this. My grandpa said they did this in elementary school."

"Oh!"

"I agree!"

"I agree!"

"I agree too!"

"That's a good idea!"

"Nice!"

[P6] The next day, Xiao Wu and A Dian put the ranking chart on the blackboard at the back of the classroom.
"Come on, Xiao Jian!"
"Thank you... thank you all!"
Later, everyone went to the teacher's office to report this to the teacher.
"Teacher, we came up with an idea. We plan to use the ranking chart to help Xiao Jian get rid of his habit of being careless!"
The teacher asked me, "Do you agree?" I happily replied:
"Yes!" "Since Xiao Jian agrees, let's do it."
I'm going to
work hard!!

[P7] Before school ended, the teacher told us, "We'll need crayons for tomorrow's art class. Remember to bring them!"
After she finished, she looked at me. Everyone else looked at me too. I smiled and made a 'V' sign with my fingers.
I was really nervous!
On the way home, I kept muttering to myself: "Crayons, crayons, crayons, crayons, crayons, crayons..."
But then, just as I was about to get home...

[P8] Xiao Jian!
I've been waiting for you for a long time! Let's play soccer!!
As a result, my carelessness level went up by one point.
A-Zhu comforted me: "Don't lose heart! Start trying hard from tomorrow!"
While playing soccer, I forgot about bringing the crayons...

[P9] Before school ended, the teacher said to us, "Tomorrow is cleaning day, remember to bring your cloth!"
After the teacher finished speaking, she looked at me. Everyone else looked at me too. I smiled and made an 'OK' gesture.

Don't worry, I've already thought of a solution.
Look, I wrote the words 'cloth' on my hand. This way, I won't forget, right? Hehe!

[P10] The next day, my carelessness level went up by one notch.
Adian comforted me: "Don't lose heart! Start paying attention from tomorrow!
It's all because of Pochi...
I'm really sorry.
Pochi, stop barking.
Woof!

[P11] But the next day, I forgot to bring something again.
I wrote down what I needed to bring, put the note in my shirt pocket, but completely forgot the note……

My carelessness score keeps rising.
Adian said to me: "This might be one of your talents too."
Ah! Ah! Ah!

[P12] For many days afterward, my ranking stayed ahead... far ahead of second place.

For many days afterward, my ranking stayed ahead... far ahead of second place.
"Xiaojian, you're amazing! I really admire you!"
"To forget things to this extent, that's incredible!"
"You're the king of losing things..."
"That's right! Xiaojian is the king of losing things!"

Everyone suddenly started clapping for me.
Huh!?

[P13] "Everyone listen to me!"
Early that morning, A-Zhu suddenly ran into the classroom and said, "Class 2 has copied our ranking list too. Their classmate Xiao Xiang is way ahead, and everyone in Class 2 calls him the 'General of Forgetting Things'!"
"Huh? What did you say!"
A-Dian hurried to Class 2 and returned with a smile.
"It's okay, he's nothing special. Our King is still better!"
"Yay!"
Yay!

[P14] "What did you say!" A student from Class 2 said after hearing this,
"The King of Class 1 forgets only small things, but our General once even forgot his backpack!"
Xiao Xiang muttered, "That's because I had to bring my planted morning glory, so I accidentally forgot my backpack..."
"Accidentally forgetting it—now that's impressive!"
"Forgetting your backpack is impressive,
but in terms of frequency, our King is even more impressive!"
"That's right! Our King once forgot things for three consecutive days."

[P15] From that day on, every morning when I arrived at school,
my classmates would ask me:
"King, did you bring your homework notebook?"
"I did." "Did you bring your lunch?"
"I did."
"Did you forget anything?"
"No." Everyone felt disappointed.
If I forgot to bring something, they would say: "You're truly the King!"
"King, you did a great job!"
I don't like
this...

[P16] The relationship between Class 1 and Class 2 has become tense because of me and Xiao Xiang.
"I heard your King didn't forget anything yesterday or today, but our General forgot his sports shoes!"
"Hmph!" "How unfair!"
"King! Keep it up!"
"King! Don't lose to Xiao Xiang!"
"Tomorrow's music class will need melodicas. Everyone remember to bring them. Also, remember to give the materials handed out to your parents."

[P17] It's so annoying, everyone is secretly following me.
"Mom, this is the material the teacher asked me to give to the parent..."

[P18] Good morning, everyone...
Ah—
I thought he'd forget
his melodica...
Oh...
"Xiaojian, you haven't been losing things lately. Great!
Your teacher is so happy. Is it thanks to your classmates' ranking chart?"
No one was happy for me,
but the teacher praised me...

[P19] "Everyone listen... our king Xiao Jian no longer forgets things. The teacher just praised him in the hallway. It's a good thing that Xiao Jian no longer forgets things. From today on, let's take down the ranking board."
Xiao Wu sighed and said, "Well, I guess we have to do it this way."
Xiao Ai said reluctantly, "Looks like the 'forgetful competition' was won by Class 2..."
"Now, please let Xiao Jian say a few words," said A Dian, then patted my shoulder.

[P20] "I'm really sorry, everyone. Lately, Achi hasn't been scaring me, and Poki hasn't been shouting at me either. But none of these are the real reason I've changed. I think I've probably... just forgotten how to be forgetful."

[P21] The surroundings suddenly fell silent. Soon, A-Zhu said, "Too... too amazing!"
A-Dian followed, saying, "Truly worthy of the King!"
"Huh?"
"Exactly! He's even forgotten how to be forgetful, the King is truly amazing!"
"Long live the King!"
"Long live the King!"
"The King is truly amazing!"

[P22] Big King, hurry up. See you tomorrow! See you tomorrow!

After removing the 'Forgetful Student' leaderboard, students from Class 1 and Class 2 became friendly again. "Big King, I haven't been forgetful lately either." 
"That's wonderful, General!"

The End
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《上学不再丢三落四》，副标题强调告别粗心马虎、学会对自己负责，作者为日本的武田美穗，译者为汪婷，出版社为北京科学技术出版社。画面中央是一个戴着皇冠、坐在宝座上的孩子，周围有许多其他孩子，背景有彩色纸屑，整体风格活泼。
[P2] 老师在走廊里叫住名叫小健的孩子，让他过去一下，画面中其他孩子在奔跑，场景充满校园日常氛围。
[P3] 老师在走廊里与小健对话，肯定他开朗活泼、记忆力强的优点，同时指出他经常丢三落四的缺点，并对此表示疑惑。
[P4] 樱老师在班级里向同学们说明小健总是丢三落四的问题，并号召大家一起想办法帮助他改掉这个缺点，同学们纷纷思考并有人提出主意。
[P5] 小爱提议制作‘丢三落四大王排行榜’，用彩色粉笔标记粗心值来帮助小健改掉丢三落四的习惯，同学们纷纷赞同并表示支持。
[P6] 同学们将制作的“丢三落四排行榜”贴在教室黑板上为小健加油，随后集体向老师汇报了这个计划，老师表示支持，小健也决心努力改正缺点。
[P7] 老师提醒同学们明天绘画课需要带蜡笔，小健在课堂上自信地比出胜利手势，但在回家路上反复念叨蜡笔却最终忘记带，画面暗示他再次丢三落四。
[P8] 小健在放学后被同学叫去踢球，虽然同学热情邀请，但他因忘记带蜡笔而感到懊恼，粗心值上升，阿助安慰他并鼓励他从明天开始努力改正。
[P9] 老师提醒明天大扫除要带抹布，小健自信地比出OK手势，随后他想到对策，把“抹布”二字写在手上，以确保自己不会忘记。
[P10] 小健因忘记带蜡笔而懊恼，第二天又因被狗叫扰而粗心值上升，同学阿典安慰他并鼓励他从明天开始改正，小健自责并道歉。
[P11] 小健尝试用纸条提醒自己带东西，但又忘了纸条，导致再次忘带物品，粗心值上升，同学阿典安慰他并开玩笑说这可能是他的才能。
[P12] 小健在‘丢三落四排行榜’上长期排名第一，同学们开始为他鼓掌并称他为‘丢三落四大王’，小健对此感到惊讶和困惑。
[P13] 阿助告诉同学们2班也设立了丢三落四排行榜，小翔排名第一并被称作‘丢三落四大将军’，小健感到惊讶；阿典去确认后回来表示小健才是更厉害的‘大王’，同学们为此欢呼雀跃。
[P14] 2班的学生与1班的小健比较谁更粗心，2班学生称自己班的‘大将军’曾忘带书包，而1班的小健则被指出曾连续三天忘带东西，引发双方对‘丢三落四之王’称号的争论。
[P15] 小健每天到校后都会被同学询问是否带齐了物品，当他带齐时大家失望，当他忘记时大家反而欢呼，小健内心感到不喜欢这种被调侃的处境。
[P16] 1班和2班因‘丢三落四’的称号竞争而关系紧张，2班学生为自己的‘大将军’加油，希望他能赢过1班的‘大王’；同时，老师提醒学生明天音乐课带口风琴并交材料给家长，小健则满头大汗，显得焦虑不安。
[P17] 小健走在路上感到烦躁，因为同学们都在偷偷跟着他；同时，他回到家向妈妈展示老师要求交给家长的材料，显得有些紧张。
[P18] 小健到校后，同学们对他不再丢三落四感到意外，老师也表扬了他，但他内心却因无人为他开心而感到失落。
[P19] 同学们得知小健不再丢三落四，决定撤掉排行榜，小舞无奈接受，小爱不甘心认为2班赢了，阿典则让小健说两句。
[P20] 小健在同学们面前坦白，自己不再丢三落四并非因为外界压力，而是因为他已经忘记了如何丢三落四，言语中流露出内心的无奈与复杂情绪。
[P21] 同学们在听到小健坦白自己忘记如何丢三落四后，先是惊讶，随后纷纷欢呼庆祝，称他为‘大王’，并高呼万岁，场面热闹非凡。
[P22] 在撤掉丢三落四排行榜后，1班和2班的学生关系缓和，一名学生向小健表示自己也不再丢三落四，小健回应称这是好事，页面以“完”字结束，标志着故事的完结。
